chunks: Had he attributed falsely any words to Us,
ai.seo_question: What would happen if the Prophet fabricated sayings and attributed them to God?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (69:44) is often linked with the subsequent verse (69:45) to discuss whether the cutting off of the 'life-force' (nafas) refers to immediate death or the cessation of revelation, affirming the Prophet's truthfulness. It serves as a divine guarantee against fabrication, reinforcing the concept of 'Ismah' (infallibility) by showing that even if he had, the consequence would have been absolute and immediate.
